d:
"The mission to rescue wild animals continues as Turtleman and Neal James answer more unusual calls for help! From snakes and turtles to raccoons, mink and other unexpected visitors, these wildlife rescue missions bring a fresh set of animal-catching and capture challenges. Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, puts his hands-on experience to work as he takes on wild animal removal jobs and helps creatures found in places where they don't belong.
Watch Call of the Wildman, Season 3, Episodes 19, 8, 15, 3, 13, 6, 10, 14 and 20, on Animal Planet India."
